title: Get fast proof of Intent attempt and Summary proof

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained Show % assertion caught loss of the reader's preference after returning from one file's Proof through Summary to another file's Proof.

Story `SEED-413#speed-intent-attempt-and-summary-proof`, plan 760, at `bacba5db52673a2d3afa18cdba01c7fe746189a4`. The mounted comparison fixture selected the published Done story. I temporarily changed `FileComparison` in `dashboard/src/IntentFileComparisonContent.tsx` to keep Show % in local file-pane state, initialized off, in place of the story reading preference. Test and fixture bytes stayed intact.

The focused check was “added and unchanged historical file Proofs distinguish absence from a measured zero” in `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-summary-story-comparison-relative.spec.ts`. The faulted trace showed Show % was checked on the added file and that the test reopened Summary, selected `root.spec.ts`, and entered Proof. The failure screenshot showed the Proof tab selected, a `dashboard/tests/root.spec.ts` timing row with `0 ms`, and an unchecked Show % control. The maintained `toBeChecked()` assertion at line 108 failed on that control. The baseline and restored runs passed that same single selected case. After the fault run I restored the source byte-for-byte, checked the unchanged tracked and untracked state again after the restored pass, and removed the clean scratch worktree. [Execution log and screenshot](</tmp/dough-plan760-coverage.Jl5OjE>)

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing checkbox assertion for this transition.

- **Test runtime.** 26.252 s total (measured runner wall time including preparation). The focused Vitest Chromium runs were 5.167 s baseline, 18.283 s faulted, and 2.802 s restored, on AC with two workers and the default timeouts.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately timed human effort was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate active agent effort measurement was recorded.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 126611 ms (measured), from 1795427203655 to 1795427330266 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — checked `bacba5db52673a2d3afa18cdba01c7fe746189a4`, Caught, no follow-up.
